changes.summary: Treat the accepted official plugin architecture as documentation, not implementation inspection. Preserve the current README delegation claim but qualify detailed plugin behavior.

before.answer: PI-Desktop offers background subagents plus its official pi.session-orchestrator plugin for durable workers; orchestration is a product/plugin capability rather than a provider-model label. SessionTask spawn calls session/create and agent/prompt, inheriting project/model/permissions. Parent can only control recorded workers; workers cannot recursively create workers through this plugin. SessionTask send targets the recorded worker; status/wait poll with bounded timeouts. Initial documented version has no worker-to-worker messaging. Subagents report to parent; durable workers expose result/accept, full transcript and open-session inspection. Plugin relationship/report persists across restart.
